subject.title: message-tool send mid-turn writes 'delivery-mirror' side-branch into transcript → permanent HTTP 400 loop, session silently dead

question: Should this mixed report remain the coordination issue for both delivery-mirror side-branch poisoning and empty signed Anthropic thinking replay, or should maintainers split it across the narrower active issue and PR paths?
rationale: The remaining work spans separate but interacting transcript-replay surfaces with open candidate PRs and provider replay compatibility risk, so automation should not choose the canonical tracking shape or final replay policy.

options.title: Coordinate Existing PRs
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the delivery-mirror side-branch work and the Anthropic replay PR, then close only after both failure classes have current-main proof.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Move the thinking-signature follow-up to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92201 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and keep this issue focused on delivery-mirror side branches.

options.title: Request Sanitized Fixture First
options.body: Ask the reporter for redacted JSONL and gateway logs before deciding whether the delivery-mirror half is still reproducible on current main.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Existing PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the delivery-mirror side-branch work and the Anthropic replay PR, then close only after both failure classes have current-main proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses provider replay, prompt-lock session ownership, and active PR coordination; steipete has recent related area work and is the strongest routing candidate in the sampled history.
